QuestInfo.name: Invasion of the Ore Snatchers
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9201050##k believes the earthquake was caused by aliens! Someone is going to have to figure out what they're up to.
QuestInfo.1: It's time for an #o9400805# attack! Eliminate them and obtain 10 of their #t4033189# items to further the research into why they're here.
QuestInfo.2: The aliens had some sort of technologically advanced shovel for mining the ore beneath #b#m600000000##k. These mineral veins are the foundation for all of Masteria. If the aliens dig up all the ore, Masteria will collapse!

0.0: My eggheads are telling me the alien base is causing these quakes! Something about the pillars of the world and strip mining. I only read the first paragraph of that report. It's 300 pages long! There's no time to sit around calculating! We need to find out why they came here!

yes.0: The aliens roaming the fields seem to be working on something. If you could eliminate the aliens and bring back a #b#t4033189##k, we could figure out what they're doing. Actually, bring back 10. The eggheads always want extra samples.

no.0: Masteria is in danger. You must help us!

yes.0: They're after our ore! Those planet-snatching, rock-loving space-jockeys! They didn't even apply for zoning permits! The ore they're taking is super-conductive. They're converting it into a power source!
yes.1: That explains the earthquake too! It must be their digging machines!\n\n\ Those ore veins are foundation of Masteria! If they dig them all out, Masteria will collapse in on itself like a big souffle! We have to stop them!

item.0: We need 10! We need a good sample of the alien #b#t4033189##k if we're going to solve this puzzler!
